purpose: Original v2.0/v2.1 creation bytecode for local compatibility regressions. These three artifacts and their repository source inputs are identical at both revisions.
reproduction: For each artifact: git show <legacyRefs revision>:<gitPath>, extract bytecode.object, and compare the decoded bytes against creationSha256. Original solc 0.8.25 standard-input recompilation reproduces the bytecode.
